title: Pin verify_dio_root_signature reject paths: tampered+expired/clockless->Reject, mismatched-carrier->Reject, no-pin->Baseline, duplicate/truncated option->Reject, expiry==now boundary
description: Review findings (b7z9.88.3, security+edge passes): the R-06-307 Baseline pins (expired/clockless->Baseline) are landed and green, but the gate's Reject dispatch at receive.rs:657-747 is almost entirely unpinned at gate level. If the expiry check (receive.rs:713) or clockless degrade (receive.rs:711) were moved ABOVE verify_signature (receive.rs:701), forged+expired and forged+clockless would silently degrade to Baseline and every current test would still pass. Minimum pins needed at gate level (verify_dio_root_signature called directly, gate_fixture pattern in rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:2899-2936): (a) tampered signature + clock past expiry => Reject; (b) tampered signature + no clock => Reject; (c) valid unexpired signature + mismatched carrier (DioFields not matching COSE payload) => Reject (cross-check arm receive.rs:721-723 is executed by NO current test); (d) no pin (announces.pin_for_test absent) => Baseline (receive.rs:691-695); (e) duplicate second 0x17 option => Reject (receive.rs:674-677) — append a second RootDioSignature to the gate_fixture body; (f) truncated/overrun option => Reject (receive.rs:670-672) — truncate body mid-option; (g) expiry == now boundary => Baseline (receive.rs:713 inlines its own <=; oracle pin at root_sig.rs:576 does not execute this operator) — clock = VECTOR_EXPIRY_UNIX exactly. root_sig.rs unit tests cover component functions, not the gate's outcome mapping.
